title: Anybody else seen a dream school styled like this before?
content: So the first floor is kind of the same as my real life school, but then on the 2nd floor it changes. There are a bunch of hallways, and lockers come in droves here and there. Rooms are kind of far apart. Another scene in the same dream showed another school in my district with more floors and gated walls in the back. I also remember some sort of fitness building with 3 floors in the back of that, and I remember jumping to the roof with an improved jump.
